players.name: Henri Veesaar
players.detail: Knee — Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

players.name: Mouhamed Gueye
players.detail: Foot — Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Keshon Gilbert
players.detail: Hip — Gilbert (hip) won't play in Saturday's Las Vegas Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: RayJ Dennis
players.detail: Achilles — Dennis (Achilles) has been ruled out for Saturday's Summer League game against the Wizards, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

players.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
players.detail: Ankle — Brown (ankle) has progressed to taking some contact in practice and said Sunday that he's "starting to get to full speed," Brian Lewis of the New York Post reports.

players.name: Kon Knueppel
players.detail: Hamstring — Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

players.name: Grant Williams
players.detail: Hamstring — Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

players.name: PJ Hall

players.name: Zach Collins

players.name: Peyton Watson
players.detail: Hamstring — Although head coach Kenny Atkinson said the starting lineup for the beginning of the 2026-27 season is not yet set, he praised Watson's (hamstring) fit in Cleveland and added that "there's a lot of room for growth in his offensive game," Chris Fedor of Cleveland.com reports.

players.name: Morez Johnson Jr.

players.name: Santi Aldama
players.detail: Undisclosed — Aldama (undisclosed) was limited during Saturday's practice, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reported.

players.name: Dereck Lively II

players.name: Spencer Jones
